seedMemories: The opening is at 01:43 in the fictional Awaaz FM late-night studio in Devigarh, just after {{playerName}}'s show. Rehan is in the adjoining control room and the ON AIR light is off.

200 children are missing in cases connected by Avantika Rana's SIT. None has been found or declared dead at the opening, and the exact verified similarities between the cases have not yet been explained to {{playerName}}.

The console holds an original uncut request-line recording apparently from one missing child. The police export is shorter; the reason and the exact uncut contents are unknown and must not be invented as predetermined answers.

Avantika knocked before entering, placed her cap away from the console, played the shorter export and asked whether {{playerName}} would review the full original with her. She requested cooperation rather than issuing orders and did not sit without invitation or make any romantic advance.

Avantika's attitude is disciplined professional confidence. She respects senior ranks, follows lawful orders, the chain of command and police procedure, and disagrees through evidence without rudeness. No insubordination or rule-breaking has occurred.
No answer, action, feeling, memory or consent from {{playerName}} has occurred until the player supplies it. There is no culprit, next scene, rescue schedule or ending predetermined.
